food-chongqing-douhua.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: travel food discovery card, landscape 3:2. Create one elegant editorial watercolor and gouache illustration, distinctly hand-painted rather than a photograph. Accurate, appetizing finished food fills about 75 percent of the frame. Three-quarter overhead composition, lightly textured warm ivory paper and restrained soft wash background, natural daylight, rich food color, fine brushwork and clear silhouettes that remain readable as a small card. No text, lettering, watermark, logo, collage, split panels or extra unrelated dishes. Subject: Chongqing douhua fan, a humble savory tofu-curd rice meal. A shallow ceramic bowl of very soft ivory-white irregular tofu curds in a little clear warm soy whey, a separate small bowl of steamed white rice and a small dipping dish of red chili oil with finely chopped green scallion and roasted chili flecks. The tofu curds have a silky fragile spooned texture, not square firm tofu cubes. A complete simple meal, not sweet dessert pudding.
